title: Uniqueness of Spherical Schwarzschild–Anti-de Sitter Spacetimes
exact_target: Establish the appropriate uniqueness theorem for spherical Schwarzschild--anti-de Sitter black holes among static negatively curved Einstein spacetimes.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006045 (OWR-14298591-009). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/36, pp. 2033--2112. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The abbreviated source target does not specify all boundary and horizon hypotheses. They must be stated before claiming that all static Einstein metrics with negative cosmological constant are Schwarzschild--AdS.
